narration: A pre-approved card arrived in month {fork_month}, unasked, and you chose {real_choice}. The ghost, holding the same card, chose {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to come apart, in month {first_bar_apart_month}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Its cushion for a stretch without pay ended {safety_gap}.
